title: BREAKING: Trump Moves to OBLITERATE Bogus NY Fraud Case That Plagued His Campaign | Next News Network
text:
President Donald Trump is taking the gloves off in his battle against one of the most blatantly political prosecutions in American history, filing a bombshell 119-page brief with New York's Court of Appeals demanding they wipe away the entire civil fraud case brought by radical Attorney General Letitia James.
The move represents Trump's most aggressive push yet to completely dismantle what conservatives have long recognized as a weaponized legal system designed to interfere with his presidential campaigns and drain his resources through endless court battles.
James, who literally campaigned on a promise to "get Trump," secured a massive judgment against the President in a case that legal experts called unprecedented and politically motivated from day one. The Democrat prosecutor targeted Trump's business empire with claims that defied decades of standard real estate practices in New York.
Fighting Back Against Legal Warfare
What makes this case so outrageous is that there were no actual victims - the banks involved in Trump's transactions were satisfied with their deals and suffered no losses. Yet James pursued the case anyway, seeking to financially cripple Trump during his successful 2024 presidential campaign.
"This was never about justice - it was about election interference, plain and simple. Letitia James turned the New York AG's office into an arm of the Democrat Party."
The timing of Trump's appeal filing shows he's not backing down from the Deep State's coordinated attacks. Now that he's back in the White House with a mandate from the American people, Trump is systematically dismantling the bogus cases that Democrats used to try to destroy him.
Patriots across the country are watching to see if New York's highest court will uphold the rule of law or continue the partisan witch hunt that has made New York a laughingstock in legal circles. Will the Court of Appeals finally put an end to this political persecution, or will they rubber-stamp another attack on the duly elected President of the United States?
